SmartClean 1.0.5 — adds four new platforms: NeoForge 26.3, Forge 1.19.2, Fabric 1.21.1 and Fabric 1.20.1.

- New builds: NeoForge 26.3 (26.3.0.118), Forge 1.19.2 (43.4.0), Fabric 1.21.1 and Fabric 1.20.1 (Fabric Loader 0.16+ plus Fabric API required).
- NeoForge 26.3 registers its config as ModConfig.Type.LOCAL: FML 12 renamed COMMON/SERVER to LOCAL/SYNCED. The file is still config/smartclean-common.toml.
- Forge 1.19.2 keeps the same feature set but renders through PoseStack, since 1.19.2 has no GuiGraphics.
- The Fabric builds have no ForgeConfigSpec, so the config is read by a small built-in TOML reader at the same path with the same keys and defaults.
- All eight builds share mod_version 1.0.5; the existing 1.20.1/1.21.1/26.1.2/26.2 builds keep the same behaviour.

---
SmartClean 1.0.5：新增四套平台 NeoForge 26.3、Forge 1.19.2、Fabric 1.21.1 与 Fabric 1.20.1。

- 新构建：NeoForge 26.3（26.3.0.118）、Forge 1.19.2（43.4.0）、Fabric 1.21.1 与 Fabric 1.20.1（需 Fabric Loader 0.16+ 与 Fabric API）。
- NeoForge 26.3 的配置改为 ModConfig.Type.LOCAL 注册（FML 12 把 COMMON/SERVER 更名为 LOCAL/SYNCED），文件名仍是 config/smartclean-common.toml。
- Forge 1.19.2 功能集不变，界面改用 PoseStack 绘制（1.19.2 没有 GuiGraphics）。
- Fabric 版没有 ForgeConfigSpec，配置由内置的极简 TOML 读写器处理，路径、键名与默认值与其他加载器一致。
- 八套构建统一为 mod_version 1.0.5，已有的 1.20.1/1.21.1/26.1.2/26.2 构建行为不变。
